title: onopordum tauricum subsp. humile
intro: Onopordum tauricum subsp. humile, commonly known as Dwarf Cabbage Thistle, is a plant species within the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Onopordum tauricum subsp. humile include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
